variants.name: switch
variants.help: A story switch is on (or off).

is.help: true: it must be on; false: off.

variants.name: variable
variants.help: A story variable compared with a number.

variants.name: alive
variants.help: Some living unit matches.

variants.name: dead
variants.help: A unit that matches exists (or existed) and none is alive.

variants.name: round
variants.help: The round number compared with a number.

variants.name: carries
variants.help: A living matching unit carries the item (not its storage).

variants.name: researched
variants.help: A side has finished a technology.

variants.name: sees
variants.help: A team sees a matching unit (fog of war).

team.help: The team (a side id means its team).

variants.name: hasSkill
variants.help: A living matching unit has the skill.

variants.name: support
variants.help: Two characters' support level compared with a number.

support.help: The two characters of a support pair.

variants.name: hasCondition
variants.help: A matching unit has a status condition.

variants.name: actor
variants.help: The unit that set this event off matches.

variants.name: difficulty
variants.help: The difficulty the battle was built with (the game needs difficulties).

difficulty.help: A difficulty, or at least / at most one.

atLeast.help: This difficulty or a harder one.

atMost.help: This difficulty or an easier one.

variants.name: rosterAlive
variants.help: A campaign character is alive (on this map, or in the roster).

rosterAlive.help: A character id (letters, digits, _ and -); it need not be on this map.

variants.name: rosterDead
variants.help: A campaign character fell.

variants.name: inRoster
variants.help: A campaign character is in the roster and not gone.

variants.name: battle
variants.help: At the start of the battle, or when it is decided.

battle.help: start: before the first turn; beforePrep: on the map before the preparation screen (right before start on a map without one); won / lost: when decided; end: either.

variants.name: turn
variants.help: At the start of a side's turn in a round (every round for "every").

turn.help: A round number, or every round.

variants.name: reach
variants.help: A unit ends a move inside the area.

variants.name: defeated
variants.help: A matching unit is defeated.

variants.name: fight
variants.help: Just before a fight in which a matching unit takes part.

variants.name: talk
variants.help: Adds Talk to the first unit's menu next to the second unit.

talk.help: The unit that starts the talk.

variants.name: promoted
variants.help: A matching unit was promoted.

variants.name: support
variants.help: A support pair reached a level.

support.help: The two characters of the pair.

level.help: Fires at this level (default: any new level).

variants.name: place
variants.help: A door or chest of the map was opened, a place visited or destroyed.

is.help: What happened to it (a door or chest is opened, a place visited or destroyed).

variants.name: say
variants.help: A line of dialogue.

speakerName.help: A name shown instead, for someone who is no unit.

portrait.help: Portrait id (text for the player to look up).

position.help: Where the speaker stands on the stage.

auto.help: The line goes on by itself after this many milliseconds.

variants.name: narrate
variants.help: A line with no speaker.

auto.help: The line goes on by itself after this many milliseconds.

variants.name: addUnit
variants.help: Puts a unit on the map.

addUnit.help: The unit, as a map's units list writes it.

variants.name: removeUnit
variants.help: Takes matching units off the map (no defeat).

hide.help: Keep the unit in the story so showUnit can bring it back.

variants.name: moveUnit
variants.help: Puts a unit on a square.

wait.help: The story waits until it arrives (needs walk).

variants.name: changeSide
variants.help: Matching units join another side.

variants.name: giveItem
variants.help: Gives an item to matching units.

variants.name: takeItem
variants.help: Takes an item from matching units.

variants.name: giveResource
variants.help: Gives (or takes) resources of a side.

variants.name: grantResearch
variants.help: A side gets a technology.

variants.name: setSwitch
variants.help: Turns a story switch on or off.

variants.name: setVariable
variants.help: Sets a story variable: a number.

variants.name: setVariable (unit's level)
variants.help: Sets a story variable: a unit's level.

level.help: The unit to read the level from.

variants.name: setVariable (unit's hit points)
variants.help: Sets a story variable: a unit's hit points now.

hp.help: The unit to read the hit points from.

variants.name: setVariable (unit's most hit points)
variants.help: Sets a story variable: a unit's most hit points.

maxHp.help: The unit to read it from.

variants.name: setVariable (unit's stat)
variants.help: Sets a story variable: one stat of a unit.

of.help: The unit to read the stat from.

variants.name: addVariable
variants.help: Adds to a story variable: a number.

variants.name: addVariable (unit's level)
variants.help: Adds to a story variable: a unit's level.

level.help: The unit to read the level from.

variants.name: addVariable (unit's hit points)
variants.help: Adds to a story variable: a unit's hit points now.

hp.help: The unit to read the hit points from.

variants.name: addVariable (unit's most hit points)
variants.help: Adds to a story variable: a unit's most hit points.

maxHp.help: The unit to read it from.

variants.name: addVariable (unit's stat)
variants.help: Adds to a story variable: one stat of a unit.

of.help: The unit to read the stat from.

variants.name: objective
variants.help: Replaces the objectives shown and the rules that decide the battle.

variants.name: win
variants.help: Ends the battle: this team wins.

win.help: A team name or a side id.

variants.name: lose
variants.help: Ends the battle: this team loses.

lose.help: A team name or a side id.

variants.name: if
variants.help: Runs some commands only when all the conditions hold.

variants.name: endTurn
variants.help: Ends the talking unit's turn (talk events only).

variants.name: focus
variants.help: Scrolls the view to a unit or a square.

ms.help: How long the scroll takes, in milliseconds.

wait.help: The story waits for the scroll to end.

variants.name: playMusic
variants.help: Plays a music track of data/audio.json.

playMusic.help: The track (a music entry of data/audio.json).

fade.help: Fade seconds (0 = a cut; default: a short cross-fade).

variants.name: stopMusic
variants.help: Silence until the next playMusic.

variants.name: playSound
variants.help: One sound effect of data/audio.json.

playSound.help: The sound (a sounds entry of data/audio.json).

variants.name: setPhaseMusic
variants.help: Changes the music a side's turn plays.

music.help: A track, none, or take the change away.

node.help: The track (a music entry of data/audio.json).

variants.name: setTerrain
variants.help: Gives squares another terrain.

area.help: The squares as a rectangle (this or cells).

cells.help: The squares one by one (this or area).

tile.help: Tile number of the tile layer (-1 = none).

variants.name: applyChange
variants.help: Applies one of the map's named changes.

variants.name: revertChange
variants.help: Puts back what a change's squares held.

variants.name: setFog
variants.help: Fog of war on or off.

variants.name: setVision
variants.help: Adds to every unit's sight (fog of war).

variants.name: openDoor
variants.help: Opens a shut door.

variants.name: closeDoor
variants.help: Shuts an open door.

variants.name: lockDoor
variants.help: Locks a door.

variants.name: unlockDoor
variants.help: Unlocks a door or chest.

variants.name: openChest
variants.help: Opens a chest.

by.help: The unit that gets the contents.

variants.name: setBehaviour
variants.help: Gives computer units a new behaviour.

variants.name: wakeGroup
variants.help: Wakes every waiting unit of a group.

wakeGroup.help: The group name of units' behaviour.

variants.name: addCondition
variants.help: Gives a status condition to matching units.

variants.name: removeCondition
variants.help: Takes a status condition (or all) off matching units.

variants.name: promote
variants.help: Promotes a unit.

to.help: The class (needed when it has several promotions).

variants.name: teachSkill
variants.help: Matching units learn a skill.

variants.name: forgetSkill
variants.help: Matching units forget a skill.

variants.name: addSupport
variants.help: Adds support points to a pair of characters.

addSupport.help: The two characters of the pair.

variants.name: choice
variants.help: Asks a question; each answer runs its own commands.

speakerName.help: A name shown instead, for someone who is no unit.

portrait.help: Portrait id (text for the player to look up).

store.help: A variable that remembers the answer's number.

text.help: The words of the answer (different from the others).

if.help: The answer is offered only when all hold.

do.help: What happens when it is chosen.

variants.name: fight
variants.help: Two units fight, with written strikes or real rolls.

strikes.help: Written strikes (1 to 24); without them the fight is rolled.

weapon.help: Weapons the fighters use (default: the equipped ones).

fight.help: The two fighters and how the fight goes.

variants.name: showMap
variants.help: Shows another map of the game for the commands that follow, until returnMap (only in the event's own command list).

showMap.help: The map to show (not this one; a map marked cutScene in game.json is made for this).

focus.help: Where the view starts: a unit of the shown map, or a square of it.

node.help: The id of a unit of the shown map (or one the commands after the showMap add).
The square of the shown map.

variants.name: returnMap
variants.help: Back to the battle's map (the end of the event does it too).

variants.name: storeItems
variants.help: Sends matching units' items to the side's shared storage.

variants.name: showUnit
variants.help: Brings back a unit hidden by removeUnit.

variants.name: background
variants.help: Shows a background (or the map again).

background.help: A background, or null for the map.

ms.help: How long it takes, in milliseconds.

variants.name: clearStage
variants.help: Every speaker leaves the stage.

transition.help: cut: at once; fade: with a fade.

ms.help: How long it takes, in milliseconds.

variants.name: leave
variants.help: A speaker leaves the stage.

leave.help: The speaker (the id or name a say line used).

transition.help: cut: at once; fade: with a fade.

ms.help: How long it takes, in milliseconds.

variants.name: enter
variants.help: A speaker comes on stage.

enter.help: The speaker (the id or name a say line uses).

transition.help: cut: at once; fade: with a fade.

ms.help: How long it takes, in milliseconds.

variants.name: move
variants.help: A speaker moves on the stage.

ms.help: How long it takes, in milliseconds.

variants.name: shake
variants.help: Shakes the screen.

variants.name: weather
variants.help: Rain, snow or clear sky over the map.

variants.name: wait
variants.help: Pauses the story.

variants.name: fade
variants.help: Fades the screen out or in.

fade.help: out: to a colour; in: back.

ms.help: How long it takes, in milliseconds.

event.help: One event: a trigger, optional conditions and the commands to run.

id.help: Unique id in the map (letters, digits, _ and -).

if.help: Conditions judged when the event is about to run: all must hold.

repeat.help: Runs every time it fires (default: once).

marker.help: A reach event only: a marker (data/graphics.json) drawn on the squares of its area while the event can still run.
